name: Kings of Chaos
intro: Kings of Chaos is a hard rock supergroup with international membership featuring a core lineup of drummer Matt Sorum, bassist Duff McKagan, and guitarist Gilby Clarke (all then formerly of Guns N' Roses), as well as revolving appearances from members of Def Leppard, Deep Purple, Aerosmith and more.
